Hi Sarah — thanks for the export spec. Looping in Karthik (sales ops) and Laura (billing ops) so we can coordinate the acceptance criteria and timing.

Short answers up front: yes, your proposed exports are likely sufficient but we need precise field mapping and one small extra item. Please see the minimal push we need from your ERP export and from the signed artifact:

1) ERP export (CSV) required columns we ingest automatically:
   - invoice_number (string)
   - po_number (string)
   - invoice_date (ISO 8601)
   - billto_ein (EIN or Tax ID)
   - shipto_ein (EIN or Tax ID; can be blank if company-level)
   - shipto_address_line1, city, state, postal_code
   - line_items_count, total_amount_usd

2) Signed evidence (PDF) requirements we verify before release:
   - Document type: Resale certificate or signed affidavit
   - Signatory name, title, signing date
   - Declared covered states (explicit list)
   - Optional: Notarization stamp if state law requires (see LA, MS, and a few others below)

3) Matching logic: Invoice will be auto-released when the CSV row links to the invoice_number and we find a corresponding attached PDF with matching billto_ein and declared covered state that includes the shipto state. Manual review may be triggered if fields mismatch.

Next steps we recommend from our side:
- Please attach the sample export and confirm column headers exactly as in your CSV (we can map aliases).
- Upload one signed affidavit for a sample invoice so we can run it through the automated acceptance flow.
- If you prefer, we can accept a signed PDF (attached to invoice) rather than a notarized one for states that don't mandate notarization.

I'll attach a short "redwood_resale_acceptance_matrix.xlsx" with the exact column names and our acceptance logic. Karthik — can you weigh in on any commercial gating for invoice release?

Cheers,
Jonas Weber

Hi Trevor/Sarah — Laura here from Billing Ops. Quick guidance from our acceptance policy to help you map fields and decide on the affidavit workflow:

- Aliases: We can map your 'CustTaxID' / 'ShipTaxID' to our internal fields; no need to rename as long as the CSV includes an alias header row OR you provide a fixed mapping file.
- Doc types: 'ResaleAffidavit' is acceptable as long as the PDF contains the signatory, entity name, declared covered states, and a signature date.
- Notarization vs DocuSign: For most states we accept DocuSign envelopes with a verified audit trail (signer email + timestamp). Notarization is only required where state statutes specify it or when the affidavit is incomplete (missing EIN or signatory title). Examples where we frequently ask for notarization: LA, AL, MS.

Operational notes:
- If the CSV export includes a doc_id field that matches the AP module attachment id, our ingestion can automatically mark the invoice as evidence-attached.
- If you cannot include doc_id, include an attachments_reference column with filename and upload_date. We will attempt fuzzy matching on filename + upload_date + invoice_number.

I'll approve automatic release for any test invoice that meets the above criteria. If you want, I can do a live session next week to walk through the mapping in your ERP UI.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
